provenance: FortiOS CLI wording from vendor documentation, not exercised against real hardware in this repository. Asymmetric risk: a marker that never matches costs only diagnosis detail (the state readback still fails the change), while a marker that over-matches costs a false rollback. This list is therefore deliberately narrow and carries no phrase that can appear in a successful response.
generic_note: Applied to every vendor in addition to the entries below: a device that prints a syntax error or an unknown command is rejecting the line whatever its brand.
